basic_info.description: Nestled in prime Ingleside near Ocean Ave, this beautifully updated home offers stunning hillside views, peekaboo water view, abundant light, and modern upgrades. The main level features two spacious bedrooms, a luxe bath, hardwood floors, and a charming fireplace. A chef's kitchen opens to a walkout patio and landscaped yard. The lower level boasts a 1BD/1BA in-law unit with private outdoor space, plus a versatile bonus room. A 1-car garage with ample storage completes this move-in-ready gem. Visit 26 Miramar dot com for virtual tour and video.
